title: Recipe of Elixir of Arcane Cultivation

sources.title: Recipe of Elixir of Arcane Cultivation

summary: Recipe for Elixir of Arcane Cultivation.

fields.Formula: Vitriol of Weavemoss and any Sublimate.
fields.Result: Grants one level 1 spell slot until Long Rest and replaces another elixir. The book uses Belladonna as its Sublimate example.
fields.Acquisition: Defiled Temple, X 386, Y 4, or Withers’ Epilogue room.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
